What is Tally Software Services?

Tally Software Services (TSS) is a subscription that adds a collection of services to your TallyPrime. It keeps you current with the latest technology and with changes in industry and tax rules.

You get continuous product upgrades and updates, plus connected features such as online data exchange between branches, remote access, and seamless banking and payment services. Together they help you improve business performance with fewer manual steps.

Product updatesCompliance updatesBanking and paymentsData synchronisationRemote access

Key benefits

What an active TSS gives your business.

📱

Business reports on any device, anywhere

Real-time access to important business reports from a web browser, on any device, anywhere.

  • View your important business reports anywhere, on a web browser
  • Convenience of accessing your data stays with you
  • Access reports such as Bills Receivable and Payable, Stock Summary, Sales and Purchase Register, Profit and Loss, and Balance Sheet on the go
  • Helps you make fresh, accurate decisions faster
  • Download an invoice or any report and share it on the go
🔄

Product updates

Regular product updates ensure that your TallyPrime is always in step with your changing business requirements.

  • Avail new product enhancements and major releases at frequent intervals
  • Ensure compatibility with the latest technological and statutory changes
  • Get the latest update available for TallyPrime
🏦

Banking and payment

Experience smooth, error-free banking with Tally's Banking and Payment Services.

  • Receive updates for all the latest cheque formats of banks available in your TallyPrime
  • Automatically reconcile your books of accounts with your bank statements, quickly, simply, accurately and error-free
  • Save your time, manpower and money
🔗

Online data synchronisation

Decentralisation of your books of accounts across branches is no longer difficult. With TallyPrime's data synchronisation you can synchronise data across your head office and branches, locations or warehouses.

  • Exchange and consolidate data across branches at the click of a button
  • Decide control on the direction of data synchronisation, and sync data without needing to be connected to each other all the time, on demand
  • Get complete visibility of business through consolidated reports of head office and branch offices (Balance Sheet, P&L, stock reports and more)
🌍

Remote access

Keep your business connected by using Tally's Remote Access Services and manage your business from anywhere in the world.

  • Get round-the-clock access to crucial information about your business performance, irrespective of the time or location
  • Manage cash flows, bank accounts, stock positions or receivables, even when you are not in your office
  • Create and modify business transactions and other details on the go
  • Provide access to chartered accountants and tax auditors to audit data
